name: admission_waiting_list
description: Sent to the parent when the application is placed on the waiting list.
subject: Waiting list: {child_name} ({application_ref})
body: We are sorry that we are not able to offer {child_first_name} a place in Year {year_group} for {academic_year} at the moment, as the year group is full.

{child_first_name} has been placed on our waiting list and is currently at position {waiting_position}. The list is kept in the order of our published oversubscription criteria, so positions can go up or down as other children join or leave it.
We will contact you straight away if a place becomes available. You also have the right to appeal against the decision not to offer a place - please contact us and we will tell you how.

placeholders.child_first_name: The child's preferred or first name
placeholders.child_name: The child's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.academic_year: The academic year applied for, e.g. 2026/27
placeholders.waiting_position: The current position on the waiting list
